## WaterBench

The [DHI](https://www.dhigroup.com) WaterBench datasets are aimed at supporting educational, research, and exploratory activities, such as:

* Experimenting with water modeling using [MIKE Powered by DHI](https://www.dhigroup.com/technologies/mikepoweredbydhi).
* Validating hydrodynamic model outputs with observational data.
* Developing methods for automatically calibrating model parameters.
* Building data-driven models, including machine learning surrogates of the MIKE simulation results.

:::

::: {.g-col-6}
